column1: # event-kinds.tsv (harbor#1367) — every kind on the local event bus: its shape, its subject, and the file that emits it.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The kinds were a prose table in docs/design/events.md, and the presets event.pulse and
# event.fleet-snapshot and the `ci` obligation listened for ci.job.done for weeks while nothing emitted it: the bus held
# 0 ci.* events (2026-10-25), and pr.merged / pr.closed had no producer either. A table nobody checks cannot say a
# listener waits on silence. Lint `event.kind-registered` holds this file to the code:
#   · every kind bin/ or hooks/ emits by name (`emit <kind>`, `emit_event`, `hook_event`) is a row here;
#   · every row's emitter exists and names its kind (a row whose emitter is `-` is a kind nothing here emits);
#   · every kind CONTRACTS/event-rules.tsv or CONTRACTS/obligation-kinds.tsv names is a row here, and a kind a preset
# A new kind is a row before it is an emit; how to wait on one is `harbor event wait`, and on CI `harbor event ci`.
# COLUMNS  kind <TAB> shape <TAB> subject <TAB> emitter <TAB> meaning
#   shape    start | terminal | point (docs/design/events.md: a start kind opens what its terminal kind closes)
#   emitter  space-separated repo paths that emit it, or - (documented, emitted by nothing on this box)
